titleAr: ليه الرسائل التسويقية محتاجة رقمك الخاص
titleEn: Why marketing needs your own number (shared-number stores)

ar: ليه مينفعش اعمل حملة على الرقم المشترك؟
en: Why can I not send marketing on the shared number?

steps: The Templates screen and the New campaign screen of a shared-number store explain that marketing messages and campaigns need its own number, with a button to connect one (rule WA-SHARED-NOCAMP-1); the campaign form is replaced by the notice, so there is no submit
edgeCases: Marketing is never sendable from the shared number, whatever a store's own copy of a template says
assistantNote: explanation only: point the merchant to connecting their own number
